# temps_notification_route (Resource)

Sends alerts within a severity range to notification providers.

Deleting a notification provider outside Terraform leaves the route with no providers; the next plan adds the configured ones back.

Import with the route ID.

Required API key permissions: `notification_providers:read`, `notification_providers:create`, `notification_providers:write`, `notification_providers:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_notification_provider" "pager" {
  name = "on-call pager"
  url  = "https://hooks.example.com/pager"
}

# Page the on-call engineer for critical and emergency alerts only.
resource "temps_notification_route" "page" {
  name         = "page on-call"
  min_severity = "critical"
  max_severity = "emergency"
  provider_ids = [temps_notification_provider.pager.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_severity` (String) Highest severity the route sends; not lower than `min_severity`.
- `min_severity` (String) Lowest severity the route sends: one of `debug`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `critical`, `emergency`.
- `name` (String) Unique route name, up to 255 characters.
- `provider_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the notification providers the alerts go to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route sends alerts. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric route ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_notification_route.page 4
```
